records.quote: Naturally, one may wonder whether the following two statements are actually also true: (i) For α ≥ 1, (λ1 , . . . , λn ) ≽_w^{exp} (λ1∗ , . . . , λn∗ ) gives rise to the usual stochastic order between X1:n and X1:n∗ ; (ii) For 0 < α ≤ 1, (λ1 , . . . , λn ) ≽^p (λ1∗ , . . . , λn∗ ) gives rise to the usual stochastic order between X1:n and X1:n∗ . The following example gives negative answers to these two conjectures. Example 3.1. Let (X1 , X2 ) ((X1∗ , X2∗ )) be a vector of independent heterogeneous GE random variables. (i) Set α = 2, (λ1 , λ2 ) = (4, 0.5) and (λ1∗ , λ2∗ ) = (2, 3). Obviously (λ1 , λ2 ) ≽_w^{exp} (λ1∗ , λ2∗ ), however X1:2 and X1:2∗ are not ordered in the usual stochastic order as can be seen in Fig. 1.
